# JsBarcode

- Version: 3.11.6 (CODE128 browser bundle).
- Source: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
- Download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsbarcode@3.11.6/dist/barcodes/JsBarcode.code128.min.js
- License: MIT, see `MIT-LICENSE.txt`.

The label page loads this local bundle directly. No CDN request or Vite build is
required when printing labels. The library encodes the full item code with
automatic Code 128 mode switching; label geometry is defined in the Blade view.
